_comment: Machine capacity for this box — how much work it can chew at once. Experiment DESIGN (which legs, parallel legs, cost/step guards) stays in combinations/*.json and the yaml configs. Env vars and CLI flags still override per-run.
_retry: How long a leg waits out a 429 before an instance dies with RateLimitError and an empty patch. Backoff caps at 60s, so attempts are roughly minutes — 6000 is days, deliberately. A 429 is not always transient: it is rate limiting, an exhausted balance, or a quota, and the last two are fixed by a human topping up rather than by time. Waiting indefinitely is still the right default, because an instance that dies takes its slot with it (a fable-5 max leg lost 80 of 105 that way, and a kimi leg lost 12 to an empty balance), while waiting costs nothing but wall clock and recovers by itself the moment the account is funded — which is exactly what happened once credit was added mid-run.
